entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I ordered a jersey and it arrived, but it just doesn't fit. I'm a bit lost with the website and the policies. I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Just so I'm clear, is the issue with the fit, or is there a technical fault with the item?
Oh, it's the fit. It's just the wrong size for me, it's way too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping for an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the process. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Getting the right size is essential. I can definitely walk you through the exchange process. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's VF-8675309.
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Apex Pro jersey, delivered on December 12th.
Is that too long ago? I'm so sorry, I've just been so busy and overwhelmed.

Not at all. For a standard item like a jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you. Would you like to do an exchange for a different size or a full refund?
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! An exchange would be perfect. I'd love to get the next size up.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds wonderful. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
